statistics_interpretation.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed scene-cluster bootstrap replicates conditional on these three training seeds; seed SD reported separately. Descriptive intervals with no multiple-comparison correction.
statistics_interpretation.actual_parent: Sbest - frozen Lbest: AbsRel -0.000761042, a numerical improvement in every seed, but CI [-0.001615003,+0.000028797] still crosses zero. RMSE and delta1 also cross zero. Boundary F1 -0.022678478 and band AbsRel -0.006581557 have intervals excluding zero and consistent directions across all seeds. Sfinal - Lbest again has inconclusive overall AbsRel/RMSE/delta1, worse F1 and better band AbsRel by the intervals. No substitution of Lfinal for the actual parent.
statistics_interpretation.best_methods: S-J: F1 worse in all seeds with CI excluding zero; other four intervals cross zero, AbsRel direction mixed. S-R: F1 worse and band AbsRel better with intervals excluding zero; overall AbsRel/RMSE/delta1 intervals cross zero despite all three numerical improvements (AbsRel upper CI +0.000001862, do not round into a positive finding). S-B0: four depth/band measures better by intervals; F1 numerical decrease in all seeds but its CI crosses zero.
statistics_interpretation.final_methods: S-Jfinal: all five aggregate intervals favor S, strongly influenced by the documented J400 seed 320114 late training instability; not uniform superiority over healthy J runs. S-Lfinal: AbsRel/band better, F1 worse by intervals, RMSE/delta1 cross zero. S-Rfinal: AbsRel/band better, F1 worse, RMSE/delta1 cross zero. S-B0final: four depth/band measures better, F1 worse with mixed seed directions.
statistics_interpretation.endpoint: Three-seed final-minus-best: boundary-band AbsRel -0.000498479 has CI [-0.000810849,-0.000194523] (seed directions mixed); other four intervals cross zero. F1 changes +0.008221428/-0.005483150/-0.003157782. Seed 114 F1 worsens 138/218, improves 70, ties 10. Pooled predicted/matched GT edge counts rise slightly while macro F1 falls, so pooled counts do not establish image-macro F1 improvement.
statistics_interpretation.counts: S100 and S400 are complete; S200/S300/S500/S577 still pending. Connecting lines across unrun intermediate counts are not measured increments.

convergence_and_cost.curve: Seed 114 starts at trained Lbest AbsRel 0.092032435, improves gradually to 0.091345968 at 1300, stops at 2300 with 0.091380373 (+0.03766%). Train loss ~0.06217->0.06110 while validation plateaus. No explosive instability; late indicator false. Ten post-best validations are retained.
convergence_and_cost.stop_rule: The raw best at 1300 is also the last >=0.2% improvement anchor. Ten later checks without such improvement lead to the frozen patience stop at 2300.
convergence_and_cost.operational_convergence: Seed 114 stable from S0, inheriting an already trained parent; <=0.10 starts at 0, confirmed at 200; <=0.09 never reached. Across S400, stable 3/3, <=0.10 3/3, <=0.09 2/3. Stability and target steps are S-stage steps unless parent costs are explicitly included.
convergence_and_cost.budget: 2300 attempts/2300 successful updates, 18400 exposures, 46 effective epochs, AMP skips 0, no failure/events. Own stage 1005.785 s (589.929 training loop,336.565 selection validation,77.463 detailed scoring); full process attempt 1020.993 s. Parent L entire 845.475 s /1300 attempts; whole route 1851.260 s /3600 attempts. Best including parent 2600 attempts /1374.955 s.
convergence_and_cost.parameters: 27089 trainable F3 parameters plus 73728 frozen LoRA parameters retained at inference,100817 total adaptation parameters.
convergence_and_cost.group_cost: Mean entire L+S 2060.787 +/-210.628 s; mean S-only 1207.898 +/-175.303 s. Whole mean attempts 4133.33, S-only2800; observational laptop wall times, not FLOP comparisons. R excludes historical shared feature preparation.

fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0005: Best/final coarse depth nearly identical. Whiteboard depth error improves versus B0 but its discontinuity stays missed. Final chair-contour cyan/yellow fragments change slightly, F1 0.353->0.339 and AbsRel 0.0722->0.0733. No broad shape improvement.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0598: Final slightly extends some cyan fragments along the right table edge; F1 0.449->0.454, AbsRel 0.03684->0.03648. Much of this edge and sofa/table-leg contours remain missed, despite lower overall depth error than B0.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_1440: Foreground chair remains a strong depth-error region versus B0; AbsRel 0.1155->0.1168. Final adds small unmatched yellow fragments around the thin chair structure, with F1 0.502->0.487 and more predicted edge pixels 3608->3807. More detected edges do not imply better matching.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0226: Both endpoints greatly reduce wall/person/sofa depth error versus B0. Final lowers AbsRel 0.2141->0.2065 but produces more unmatched branch/nearby fragments; F1 0.506->0.490 while predicted edges 9980->10622. This is a visible overall-depth versus contour tradeoff.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0246: Best/final nearly identical, with larger rear-room/shelf errors than B0. False ceiling contour and missed shelf/table boundaries persist. AbsRel 0.1650->0.1657 and F1 0.499->0.497 change slightly; avoid claiming a clear broad visual gain or loss.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0080: Final loses cyan segments on central/lower vertical shelf contours. F1 0.192->0.125 and predicted edge pixels 172->108, while AbsRel 0.0707->0.0722. Raw maps remain finite, positive and nonconstant (~1.146-2.019 m best;1.145-2.015 m final), so low edge count is not a missing prediction.

interpretation: S400 gives numerically better best AbsRel than its same-count LoRA parent in all three seeds, but the paired scene interval still crosses zero. The consistent and clearer effect is reduced boundary F1 alongside improved boundary-band depth values. Best AbsRel is nearly tied with J400, while S costs more than a single LoRA run. S avoids the observed J400 third-seed final collapse, but this does not prove universal staged superiority. Continue the predeclared counts without changing methods or selecting by test.

next_batch_startup_resources.estimate_basis: max(256 MiB, twice largest completed same-method run, or any method if none); raw datasets and shared caches already resident; fixed previews only, no full prediction archive
